review_candidates.description: Job Description Approche Tiers Conformément à L'engagement Pris De Préserver Les Capacités Et De Soutenir Le Personnel Déjà En Poste Au Sein De L'Organisation, La Majorité Des Postes Vacants Au PNUD, Au FENU Et Au Programme VNU Sont Publiés Selon Un Processus De Candidature à Plusieurs Niveaux, Dans Le Cadre Duquel Niveau 0 : Personnel international du PNUD/FENU/VNU titulaire d'un contrat permanent (PA) ou à durée déterminée (FTA), dont les postes seront supprimés, ou dont les contrats seront résiliés ou non renouvelés en 2026 Niveau 1 : Autre personnel du PNUD/FENU/VNU titulaire d'un contrat permanent (PA) ou à durée déterminée (FTA) Niveau 2 : Personnel du PNUD/FENU/VNU titulaire d'un contrat temporaire (TA), personnel sous contrat PSA régulier, et Volontaires des Nations Unies Experts et Spécialistes Niveau 3 ou aucun niveau indiqué : Tous les autres types de contrat du PNUD/FENU/VNU et d'autres agences, ainsi que les candidats externes Veuillez prendre note du ou des niveaux indiqués dans l'intitulé du poste vacant, le cas échéant, et vous assurer que vous remplissez les conditions requises pour postuler. Background Le Programme des Nations Unies pour le développement (PNUD) est le réseau mondial de développement du système des Nations Unies. Présent dans de nombreux pays, il accompagne les États dans la recherche et la mise en œuvre de solutions adaptées aux défis nationaux et mondiaux en matière de développement. À travers son expertise, ses ressources et son réseau de partenaires, le PNUD contribue au renforcement des capacités nationales, à la promotion d’un développement inclusif et durable ainsi qu’à l’amélioration des conditions de vie des populations. Le Niger fait face à un ensemble de facteurs de fragilité interdépendants, notamment l’insécurité et les violences armées, les conflits communautaires, les déplacements forcés, les inégalités socio-économiques, la faiblesse des capacités institutionnelles et locales, l’accès inégal aux services publics essentiels, le chômage et la vulnérabilité des jeunes, l’exclusion de certains groupes sociaux, ainsi que les effets croissants du changement climatique. Ces facteurs se renforcent mutuellement et affectent particulièrement les régions exposées aux conflits et aux déplacements, notamment Tillabéri, Tahoua et Agadez. Ils compromettent la cohésion sociale, la confiance entre les populations et les institutions, les moyens d’existence et les perspectives de développement durable. Dans ce contexte, le PNUD Niger, en partenariat avec le Gouvernement du Niger, met en œuvre le projet « Renforcement de la Stabilité et du Relèvement Socio-économique dans les régions de Tillabéri, Tahoua et Agadez (2026-2030) ». Le projet constitue une intervention stratégique de stabilisation et de relèvement visant à agir de manière intégrée sur les facteurs de fragilité et à consolider les acquis des interventions antérieures du PNUD, notamment ceux issus du Mécanisme de stabilisation du Liptako-Gourma. Are you an experienced professional with experience in Power Trading businesses looking for a new, exciting and start-up role to develop in? At Octopus Energy Trading, we’re on a mission to reshape the future of energy. As part of Octopus Energy Group, we’re creating an innovative approach to trading that will accelerate the transition to a Net Zero world. With the growth of renewables and a push toward decarbonising heating and transport, greater flexibility in the grid is essential. We are building cutting-edge technology to optimise everything from domestic EV charging to grid-scale batteries, to meet the global demand for energy flexibility. We’re looking for passionate and unconventional thinkers to join us on this journey, bringing a diversity of experience and ideas to shape a more efficient, flexible, and sustainable energy system. You might be used to places where trading sits in a box. It doesn’t here. We work closely with the people building the tech, the people talking to customers, the people shaping the future of the business. It means you see more, influence more, and yes, occasionally deal with a bit more chaos too. We’re pretty obsessive. About the market, about the detail, about how things actually work in the real world. We think about the system a lot. A lot, a lot. How energy flows, where it breaks, how it could be better. And then we try to fix it. Please register your interest in a role with Octopus Energy Trading and let us know what unique experience you could bring! A bit more about a role in Octopus Energy Trading... Where do we operate? Originally focusing on the GB market and now expanding into Europe and Asia, we are now looking to take our experience to new countries so would love to here from you, wherever you are in the world! What do we look for? We’re looking for people with awesome experience in the power trading world, someone who can talk through the numbers, the risk, the strategy. You know where effort matters and where it doesn’t. You won’t spend hours polishing something no one needs. And yes, writing a long meeting agenda might drain you slightly.\ You take ownership. Proper ownership. Not “that’s not my job”, more “I’ll figure it out”. Because here, you kind of have to. Our Traders... Our Traders develop transformational solutions and rapidly implement these to meet the urgent and global need for energy flexibility. You’ll be responsible for creating value from Power markets, trading the volatility, and managing our exposure. You’ll also work on the high-level trading approach, supporting in the evolving design and improvement of our in-house analytical tools. Our Data Team... With an increase in variable and distributed supply, using data for trading and forecasting has never been more important. Octopus has always had a tech-first approach, and our trading and analytics tools are all built in-house. We look for experts in building data pipelines bringing together internal and external data to create market leading insights using both classical and ML techniques. This includes looking at demand, renewables and transmission system fundamentals forecasts focussed to begin with on the GB intraday power market Our Battery Team... Flexible assets - batteries, EVs, heat pumps, and more - are key to the reliable operation of low-carbon grids. Maximising the impact of these assets across electricity markets and grid services requires making thousands of highly complex, data-driven decisions and we have built an incredible team who take ownership of this. Our Leaders... Our leaders don’t really look like “leaders” in the traditional sense, which is kind of the point… They don’t sit at a distance. They’re in it. Close to the detail, close to the work, close to the people actually doing the job. They’ll answer customer emails. They’ll jump into problems. They don’t measure themselves by team size or org charts. In fact, the opposite. If something can be simpler, smaller, faster, they’ll push for that. They’re pretty obsessive. About doing the right thing, about making things better, about not letting something slide just because “that’s how it’s always been”. They don’t hide behind process. If something’s broken, they fix it. If something’s unclear, they make a call. They give people a lot of trust. And with that comes a lot of responsibility. You won’t be micromanaged, but you also won’t be able to coast. Team culture and vision are so important to us, here’s what the team has to say… Celyn Simmonds - “Octopus Energy Trading is a new function within the Octopus Group that is tasked with managing all the Group's short term trading responsibilities. We'll be building a 24 hour shift desk, supported by world class developers, in order to optimise our flex assets (think batteries, EV's, heat pumps..), retail, and renewable energy portfolio, as well as taking speculative positions. We're a small, dedicated function who work fast, dynamically and look out for each other; it's a start-up atmosphere with the benefits of the resources of a larger company.” Alissa Tripp - “Working in the Octopus trading team has been a fantastic experience - it's a space where innovation and teamwork create tangible impact, and it is a very collaborative environment to operate in. Being part of such a dynamic team has definitely pushed me to grow in ways I hadn't expected.” This is a speculative posting for now. We’re growing quickly and expect to be hiring in this space across different countries, so tell us where you’re based and we’ll be in touch when the right role comes up P.S. as this is speculative interest you might not hear from us for up to 3 months. P.P.S. always keep a look out on our live job board for other opportunities that open up. Where necessary, we sometimes use AI tools to help with parts of our hiring process, like reviewing applications or assessing responses. We’re lucky to receive a huge amount of interest, so these tools help our recruiters manage that volume, not replace them. Ultimately, every hiring decision (for example, whether to progress your application or not) is always made by a real person in our Talent team. If you’d like to know more about how we use your data, you can reach out to us via email at talent@octoenergy.com. We’re happy to help!

Assist in Developing, deploying, and maintaining a common curriculum and inventory of sales processes and solutions that deliver best in class execution on the key areas of salesforce deployment, opportunity pipeline and account planning. Analyze sales data and metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Provide operational support to BA META Leaders including order forecasting and pipeline management. Provide pipeline updates and analyses, offering insights for reviews at regional, global, and executive levels. Assist in the implementation of sales tools and methodologies to enhance sales performance. Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess the effectiveness of sales strategies and processes. Including the development and implementation of tactics to improve win rates/accelerate sales cycle improvements. Participate in AOP development processes, lead Annual Sales Quota deployment. Support cross-functionally within the CCO organization to bring in data-driven insights and drive actions for growth. Qualifications YOU MUST HAVE 5+ years of transferrable experience in sales operations or sales support roles. Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, engineering or related field. Strong knowledge of sales processes, data management, and sales analytics. Experience with CRM systems and sales tools relevant to sales operations. Ability to analyze complex data and provide actionable insights. Proficiency in sales forecasting and pipeline management. WE VALUE Experience in the building automation, software sales or related industrial technology sectors. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional team environment. Continuous learning mindset and adaptability to changing business needs. Required Skills Sales Operations Expertise: Strong understanding of sales processes, methodologies, and tools to effectively lead. Proficiency in Salesforce CRM for opportunity tracking, pipeline management, and sales execution. Analytical Proficiency: Excellent analytical skills to interpret complex data and draw actionable insights. Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI for performance analysis and strategic insights. Leadership Skills: Demonstrated ability to motivate and manage teams effectively, fostering a collaborative environment. Problem-Solving Skills: Strong aptitude for identifying challenges and formulating innovative solutions. Training and Development Experience: Proven track record in developing and executing impactful training programs. Communication Skills : Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to convey complex information clearly. Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy and attention to detail when analyzing data and reporting findings.
